status: pilot; retrospective public data; not clinically or field validated

scope.out_of_scope: other speeds, grades, terrain, loads above 15 kg, continuous sensor streams

tracks.primary: unseen people, loads 0/5/10/15 kg, inputs mass/stature/age/load (+ optional declared sex)
tracks.calibration: unseen people; the person's measured 0 kg power is revealed; scored on 5/10/15 kg only; reported separately
tracks.holdout15: 15 kg rows withheld from training; scored on 15 kg for unseen people; reported separately

budget.status: provisional design defaults; profiled baselines use far less (see docs/LOAD_TASK.md)

skill.frozen_on: 2026-10-17, from the seed-0 ridge baseline run before any participant run

ranking_policy: valid runs rank above invalid runs; raw metrics retained; LLM process score never combined with numerical score
